transport: Pinned source weights were served from a disposable local cache. All destination repository creation, privacy updates, model cards, uploads and downloaded artifact verification used the live huggingface.co service through a credential-isolating relay.
harness_notes: Initial downloaded JSON failed size checks because the relay reserialized JSON. Final checks used a byte-preserving relay and verified SHA-256 for every listed artifact.

A preliminary existing-repository scenario loaded a model from a local directory and encountered Hub model-card base_model validation. The final public-to-private scenario used the pinned Hugging Face model ID and passed. The unchanged local-path model-card case remains outside this PR fix.
limitations: 16-bit merged upload fails on both merge base and head with an unexpected safe_serialization keyword.
Three existing Core zoo CI jobs still fail; this verification does not claim all repository CI is green.
GPU execution was limited to one NVIDIA card and one small text model. No live macOS/MLX, Windows, XPU, multi-GPU, adapter, vision, audio, GGUF-export or training matrix was run.
GPU reload was an inference smoke check, not a model-quality or quantized-kernel performance evaluation.
Permission-denied and partial-failure cases were HTTP-mocked contract checks, not tests with a second restricted live credential.
